issues.title: Say goodbye in Spanish
issues.author: trial
issues.body:
## What to build

A `farewell(name)` function next to `greet`, for the goodbye line: `¡Adiós, Ana!`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] `farewell("Ana")` returns `¡Adiós, Ana!`
- [x] A test covers it
- [ ] The goodbye prints on a Windows console whose code page is cp1252, not only on macOS

## Outcome

Completed by #3, except the third criterion, left unticked: the goodbye was only run on macOS. Nobody has printed it on a Windows console (cp1252) yet. That check is still open for the next session.

issues.title: Repeat the greeting with --count
issues.author: trial
issues.body:
## What to build

`--count N` repeats the greeting N times on one line: `python -m probe --count 2 Ann` prints `Hello, Ann! Hello, Ann!`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `--count 2 Ann` prints the greeting twice, separated by a space
- [ ] Without `--count` the output is unchanged
- [ ] A count below 1 is refused with a message and exit status 2

pulls.title: feat: say goodbye in Spanish
pulls.author: trial
pulls.body:

Adds `farewell(name)` in `src/probe/farewell.py`, which says goodbye in Spanish. Part of #1.

Not verified: the output on a Windows console (cp1252); only run on macOS.
